Versioned components evolve contracts incompatibly.
Compositional reductions hide a counterexample requiring more global state.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Assume/guarantee can relocate rather than eliminate the specification problem.
Checking interface compatibility may still require global reasoning for cyclic liveness or quantitative resources.
Contracts can become bureaucratic if no substitution or decision consumes them.
Empirical model-code defects show that verified component abstractions can fail at integration shims [S092].
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Interference checks evolved into rely/guarantee, interface automata, contract-based design, compositional model checking, separation-logic resource protocols and layered refinement. Mature practice uses contracts at architectural seams, checks compatibility mechanically and escalates only unresolved global properties.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Large systems are decomposed by explicit, versioned assumptions and guarantees that compose mechanically. Circularity, global invariants, liveness and shared resource bounds are checked separately; contracts with no live consumer are not retained as ceremony.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Owicki–Gries and Jones provide direct foundational compositional lineages.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Local and composition theorems are rigorous when compatibility, circularity and closure conditions hold.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Contracts and composition proofs can be replayed with exact component versions.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Interface-to-code correspondence and unmodelled integration shims remain separate burdens.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Verdi, IronFleet and CertiKOS use layered/compositional structures.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Case evidence is strong; controlled evidence on optimal contract granularity is weak.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Compositional evidence is compatible with assurance standards but method-specific.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Broadly transferable where boundaries are real and stable; not universally cheapest.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Compatibility, circularity, global liveness and interface fidelity determine validity.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Integration defects and hidden-assumption criticism materially constrain naïve compositional confidence.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can global liveness and resource properties be decomposed without circular proof?
What contract granularity minimises both hidden coupling and maintenance cost?
How should empirical service-level behaviour discharge quantitative assume/guarantee conditions?

properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: static analysis and abstract interpretation lineage
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Abstract interpretation formalised sound approximation of concrete semantics in lattices; model checking later used predicate abstraction and CEGAR, while data refinement used abstract state representations and retrieve relations [S005, S010, S061].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Concrete programs and systems are too large or infinite to analyse directly. Removing details can make analysis tractable, but an unsound or claim-inappropriate abstraction can miss real failures or generate unusable spurious alarms.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Abstraction must preserve properties needed by the claim and mark over/under-approximation explicitly.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Concrete programs and systems are too large or infinite to analyse directly. Removing details can make analysis tractable, but an unsound or claim-inappropriate abstraction can miss real failures or generate unusable spurious alarms.
properties.MECHANISM: Define concrete and abstract domains, abstraction/concretisation relation, direction of approximation and property-preservation theorem. For over-approximation, all concrete behaviours must be represented; for under-approximation, claims are explicitly bug-finding only. Validate precision through counterexamples, CEGAR, domain-specific abstractions and sound numerical models.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger when exact state exploration or proof is infeasible but a conservative or witness-seeking approximation can answer a material question.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For small finite systems or deterministic local rules, analyse the concrete state directly instead of introducing abstraction risk.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Defined concrete semantics, target property, approximation direction and a strategy for spurious/missed behaviour.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The property is preserved by the chosen abstraction relation.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Soundness theorem, domain/transfer-function correctness and precision controls are explicit.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Concrete semantics includes relevant environment/hardware effects before abstraction.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: The “concrete” analysed model corresponds to source/binary/runtime at the claimed level.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Abstract transformers, widening, solver and front-end encodings are trusted or checked.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Code/semantics/property changes can invalidate domain assumptions and require abstraction regression.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Makes otherwise intractable analysis possible, supports scalable static checking/model checking, and turns spurious traces into a disciplined refinement loop.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: An under-approximation is reported as proof of absence.
Over-approximation is sound but produces overwhelming false positives.
The abstraction merges states whose distinction is essential to the property.
Widening loses an invariant needed to prove safety.
Environment or floating-point semantics are abstracted inconsistently.
A spurious counterexample is dismissed without refining the responsible abstraction.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Soundness and usefulness trade off: a perfectly sound analysis can be operationally unusable.
Abstraction theorems cover only the formal concrete semantics, which may itself omit implementation/environment behaviour.
CEGAR does not guarantee rapid convergence or a sufficiently expressive predicate domain [S061].
Recent work continues to show fundamental incompleteness/scalability limits and hard reduction problems [S103].
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Manual data abstraction evolved into abstract domains, widening/narrowing, predicate abstraction, CEGAR, symmetry and partial-order reductions, compositional summaries and domain-specific analysers such as Astrée. Mature use treats abstraction design and counterexample validation as engineering work, not a hidden solver detail.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Every abstract result states approximation direction, preserved property, omitted distinctions and spurious-result policy. Sound over-approximation supports absence claims only for the modelled concrete semantics; under-approximation supports witness finding only. Precision is tuned to a named decision.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Cousot–Cousot and CEGAR provide direct mathematical and algorithmic provenance.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Sound over-approximation provides rigorous absence results under its concrete semantics; under-approximation does not.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Static analyses and model-checking abstraction loops are mechanically repeatable.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: The abstraction theorem starts from a formal concrete model, not necessarily deployed code/environment.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Astrée and SDV demonstrate major industrial applications of tailored abstraction.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Industrial cases are strong but comparative false-positive/effort data are domain-dependent.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: DO-333 case studies treat abstract interpretation as a recognised formal-method technique.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Approximation discipline transfers broadly; individual domains and soundness costs do not.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Direction, concrete semantics, property preservation and precision determine the result.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: State-explosion, spuriousness, incompleteness and empirical correspondence evidence strongly constrain use.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can abstractions be synthesised for semantic relevance rather than benchmark performance?
What practical thresholds identify a sound analyser whose false-positive burden destroys net value?
How should learned/AI-generated abstractions be independently validated?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Data refinement in VDM/Z/B related abstract and concrete states; simulation and process equivalence supplied behavioural correspondence; CompCert and verified systems later used chains of forward/backward simulation or contextual refinement [S010–S013, S019, S024, S027].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A property proved of an abstract design does not automatically hold for a lower-level model or implementation. Representation changes, new nondeterminism, compiler transformations or concurrency can introduce behaviours absent from the abstraction.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A lower-level implementation/model must refine the abstract property through a stated simulation/equivalence relation.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A property proved of an abstract design does not automatically hold for a lower-level model or implementation. Representation changes, new nondeterminism, compiler transformations or concurrency can introduce behaviours absent from the abstraction.
properties.MECHANISM: State an observation relation and refinement criterion; construct retrieve relation or forward/backward simulation showing initial-state correspondence and step/trace preservation, including stuttering, termination and divergence conditions. Compose refinements across layers and check side conditions.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever evidence at one abstraction level is used to control a lower-level model, source, binary or component substitution.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a direct executable specification or tiny transformation, differential/conformance testing may supply enough correspondence more cheaply.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Formal semantics at both levels, observation relation, initial-state mapping and complete transformation/layer inventory.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The abstract property is invariant under the chosen refinement relation.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Retrieve/simulation relation covers representation and nondeterminism without hiding material observations.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Both levels use compatible environment, fault and scheduler assumptions.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Every deployed transformation/layer is either in the refinement chain or explicitly trusted/validated.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Semantics, proof assistant, translator and certificate checker are bounded.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Any layer, compiler option, source semantics or observation change triggers affected refinement replay.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Allows abstract reasoning to survive implementation detail, supports verified compilation and layered systems, and makes model-code gaps concrete proof obligations.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: The refinement relation preserves outputs but not timing, confidentiality or liveness observations.
Forward simulation is insufficient in the presence of nondeterminism/divergence without additional conditions.
Undefined source behaviour makes the compiler theorem permissive.
A representation invariant is assumed rather than established at initialisation.
Layer proofs do not compose because observation models differ.
Implementation contains unmodelled code paths or optimisations.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Refinement proves the chosen observational relation, not every desired property.
Semantic preservation can be weak or vacuous for undefined/unspecified source behaviour.
Simulation proofs are technically strong but can hide human-selected correspondence relations.
Empirical verified-system defects show gaps outside the proved refinement layers [S092].
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Manual data refinement evolved into refinement calculus, action-system refinement, contextual refinement, concurrent separation-logic refinement, compiler semantic preservation, translation validation and per-run certificates. The mature form names the observer and property class preserved at each layer.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A high-level proof controls implementation only through a versioned, composable refinement/correspondence chain with explicit observations, divergence/termination treatment and unmodelled code boundary. Where full refinement is too costly, use conformance tests or translation validation and narrow the claim.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: VDM/Z/B, process semantics and verified compiler/kernel work provide direct plural provenance.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Simulation/refinement theorems are mathematically strong for their observation and semantic models.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Machine-checked refinement chains and per-run certificates are replayable.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Correspondence can be very strong in CompCert/seL4-like chains, but drops sharply at omitted layers.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: CompCert, seL4, CertiKOS, FSCQ and verified verifiers provide major cases.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Strong cases exist; empirical comparative evidence and maintenance economics are limited.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Formal correspondence is central to certification credit and high-assurance architectures.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Any abstraction-to-implementation claim needs correspondence, though the exact relation is domain-specific.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Observation choice, undefined behaviour, divergence and omitted layers determine what transfers.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: TCB analyses and empirical defects directly show why refinement scope must be stated.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which refinement notions best combine functional, temporal, security and quantitative observations?
How can refinement chains be maintained incrementally across architecture and compiler changes?
When is translation validation more economical than a global compiler/refinement proof?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Formal specification methods originally relied on disciplined refinement or code generation to connect model and program. Translation validation, verified compilers, binary verification and model extraction made this link an explicit artefact rather than an informal claim [S023–S026].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The model may be correct while the deployed code, build options, generated artefacts, adapters, configuration or binary does something else. “The design was verified” is therefore not implementation assurance.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A verified model must be tied to the actual source/binary/configuration or treated as design evidence only.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: The model may be correct while the deployed code, build options, generated artefacts, adapters, configuration or binary does something else. “The design was verified” is therefore not implementation assurance.
properties.MECHANISM: Maintain a traceable identity chain from requirement/model to source, generated code, compiler/linker options, binary, configuration and deployed instance. Establish correspondence by refinement proof, verified generation, translation validation, conformance/model-based tests, binary equivalence or runtime trace checking. Record any unverified glue.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever a formal result is used to claim anything about source code, binaries, configured services or deployed hardware.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For design exploration only, label the result design-level and avoid pretending to establish implementation correctness.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Immutable artefact identities, build provenance, model/source mappings, configuration capture and transformation inventory.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The formal claim states the concrete artefact level to which it is intended to apply.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Mappings preserve relevant events, data domains and observations.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Deployment platform/configuration is within the modelled usage domain.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: This is the property itself: an explicit, checked link rather than naming similarity or process documentation.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Generators, compilers, extractors, linkers, build tools and validators are proved, validated or trusted explicitly.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Hash/version/configuration mismatch immediately downgrades or invalidates correspondence evidence.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents model-only assurance from controlling a deployment decision, focuses verification on risky transformations and glue, and makes the provenance of “formally verified” artefacts auditable.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Manual code diverges from a verified design model.
Generated code is edited or regenerated with different tool/version/options.
The verified source is not the source used for the deployed binary.
Adapters, shims or configuration violate model assumptions.
Code extraction/model extraction mistranslates semantics.
A model-checker counterexample is infeasible in code—or code has behaviours absent from the model.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: This is often the weakest evidence dimension despite very strong in-model proof.
The empirical study of verified distributed systems found concrete defects outside verified models [S092].
seL4 and CompCert sources explicitly document residual source/binary/hardware and toolchain boundaries [S093, S094].
Certification documentation can establish traceability procedures without proving live deployed identity.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Informal refinement claims evolved into generated-code chains, verified compilers, translation validation, per-run proof certificates, binary verification, reproducible builds and attestation. Mature practice grades correspondence strength instead of treating it as binary.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Every real-world formal claim states its correspondence level: design only, source linked, generated source, compiled binary validated, or deployed instance attested. Gaps and glue code receive targeted tests/review; evidence is invalidated when identities diverge.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Refinement, translation validation and verified compilation provide direct lineage.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: A semantic refinement or binary validation theorem can be rigorous for the covered chain.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Certificates, proofs and reproducible identity checks can be replayed per artefact.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: This dimension is the property: design-only evidence is low; end-to-end binary/refinement chains can be high.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: CompCert, seL4 and per-run verifier validation demonstrate mechanisms.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Fonseca et al. directly document model/implementation boundary failures.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Certification and reusable-component guidance require configuration/traceability and usage-domain control.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Any deployed claim needs it; technique and attainable strength vary.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Build, configuration, platform, glue and semantic mapping assumptions dominate.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Empirical defects and TCB analyses provide unusually direct contrary evidence against implicit correspondence.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can model-code mappings be kept current at low cost in fast-changing codebases?
What correspondence evidence is sufficient for dynamic configuration, plugins and remote services?
How should reproducible build and attestation evidence compose with semantic refinement proofs?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Foundational model checking algorithmically explored all reachable states of a finite transition system; SPIN operationalised explicit-state search, symbolic model checking represented sets of states compactly, and Alloy popularised finite bounded model finding [S007–S009, S016].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Reviews and conventional tests sample executions and miss rare interleavings, corner states and transition combinations. For a finite tractable model, exhaustive search can settle reachability or temporal properties and return witnesses.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Finite/bounded state models should be exhaustively searched when the state space is decision-relevant and tractable.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Reviews and conventional tests sample executions and miss rare interleavings, corner states and transition combinations. For a finite tractable model, exhaustive search can settle reachability or temporal properties and return witnesses.
properties.MECHANISM: Construct a finite or finitised transition model, enumerate or symbolically compute reachable states, check invariant/temporal formulas, and emit counterexample traces. Record state count, reductions, fairness, resource limits and whether exploration was genuinely complete.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger for finite protocols, controllers, configurations or small concurrent designs where exhaustive exploration is tractable and consequential.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use simulation, testing or bounded search when the model cannot be made finite without excluding the failure class or when a simple invariant suffices.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Finite state encoding, complete transition/environment model, explicit property, resource-completion evidence and sound reductions.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: Formula is nonvacuous and its witnesses/counterexamples have engineering meaning.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Finitisation and reductions preserve the checked property; under-approximations are labelled.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Relevant nondeterministic/fault behaviours are included in the finite model.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Model states/actions correspond to the claimed design or implementation level.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Search algorithm, state encoding, reductions and solver back ends are trusted or validated.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Model/property/tool changes require fresh completion metrics and replay.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Finds rare ordering/state defects with concrete traces and can prove absence within a finite model more decisively than sampled testing.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: State space is finite only because relevant data, faults or participants were bounded away.
Search terminates by timeout/memory limit but is reported as exhaustive.
Symmetry/partial-order reduction is unsound for the property.
State hash compression or bitstate search sacrifices completeness without disclosure.
The model omits environment or implementation behaviours.
A property passes vacuously or due to unreachable initial states.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Exhaustiveness applies to represented states, not every real behaviour.
State explosion can make complete search impossible even for finite models [S008, S103].
Abstraction and reduction introduce proof obligations and possible spuriousness.
No counterexample is weak evidence when bounds or coverage are unclear.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Explicit search evolved into BDD symbolic checking, SAT/SMT bounded checking, partial-order/symmetry reduction, abstraction/CEGAR, compositional and probabilistic/timed model checking. Mature use distinguishes exhaustive finite proof from bounded bug finding and chooses a small model around the risky mechanism.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use exhaustive exploration when a decision-relevant finite state space can be justified and completed. Publish the model, property, bounds, reductions, explored state/transition counts and completion status; pair with correspondence and vacuity checks.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Model checking, SPIN, symbolic model checking and Alloy directly establish finite exhaustive analysis.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Model-check runs are replayable with pinned model/tool/resources.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Exhaustion says nothing about model-code/environment adequacy.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Finitisation, reductions, property, initial states and environment define the theorem.

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Model checking distinguished itself from traditional proof by producing diagnostic counterexample executions; SPIN error trails and Alloy instances made falsifying traces/structures central engineering artefacts [S007, S009, S016].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A failed proof obligation or red status may not reveal a repairable defect. Engineers need the concrete sequence, state assignment or witness showing how the property fails—and whether that witness is feasible in the intended system.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Counterexamples are high-value engineering artefacts only when trace feasibility and abstraction validity are checked.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A failed proof obligation or red status may not reveal a repairable defect. Engineers need the concrete sequence, state assignment or witness showing how the property fails—and whether that witness is feasible in the intended system.
properties.MECHANISM: Generate minimal or readable counterexample traces; map model states/actions to domain events; validate initial-state feasibility, abstraction concretisability and implementation reproducibility; classify as product defect, specification defect, abstraction artefact or expected excluded behaviour.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever a checker finds a violation or failed obligation that must drive design/code/specification action.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a direct deterministic assertion failure, the ordinary failing input and stack trace may already be the cheapest witness.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Trace semantics, domain mapping, concretisation/reproduction path and defect-classification process.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The violated property is reviewed before attributing blame.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Spuriousness/concretisability can be tested or clearly bounded.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: The trace’s environment choices are feasible or intentionally adversarial.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Actions and state values can be mapped to implementation events or explicitly labelled design-only.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Trace generation, minimisation and explanation preserve a real violating path.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Accepted counterexamples are tied to model/code versions and retained as regressions after repair.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Shortens diagnosis, converts exhaustive reasoning into actionable reproductions, and exposes incorrect assumptions/specifications early.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Counterexample exists only in an over-abstract model.
Trace starts from an impossible initial state or violates an unstated assumption.
The tool truncates or renders a trace too opaquely to diagnose.
A real counterexample is dismissed because it conflicts with design intent.
The property is wrong, but the witness is misclassified as a code defect.
Teams optimise trace length rather than causal usefulness.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: A counterexample to an abstraction is not necessarily an implementation bug [S061].
Diagnostic value depends on model-code mapping and comprehensibility.
Counterexamples can encourage local patching without strengthening the specification or model.
Unsat/no-counterexample evidence does not share the same intuitive witness strength.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Raw state dumps evolved into shortest traces, causal slicing, counterexample explanation, CEGAR concretisation checks, test-case generation and proof-assistant/LLM explanation aids. Mature practice treats the trace as evidence to be validated and classified, not automatic blame.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Every counterexample is reviewed for feasibility, property validity, abstraction origin and correspondence. properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Bounded model checking encoded executions up to depth k as SAT, and CBMC applied bounded unwinding to C programs. Alloy similarly made finite scope an explicit analysis choice [S016, S036, S037].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Finite-depth reasoning is powerful for bug finding but is easily marketed as proof. A green run may merely mean no counterexample exists within the chosen depth, loop unwind, integer width, object scope or participant count.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Bounded model checking/model finding must publish the bound/scope and never sell no-counterexample as unbounded proof.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Finite-depth reasoning is powerful for bug finding but is easily marketed as proof. A green run may merely mean no counterexample exists within the chosen depth, loop unwind, integer width, object scope or participant count.
properties.MECHANISM: Record every bound and completeness threshold; distinguish bug-finding result from proof; prove a completeness diameter/cutoff when possible; add unwinding assertions; increase bounds systematically; report timeout/unknown separately; use induction or unbounded proof for universal claims.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever SAT/SMT/model-finding/symbolic search limits depth, objects, participants, loops or numeric domains.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: If a finite state space is genuinely exhausted, report that directly; if one deterministic edge case is at issue, use a direct test.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Complete list of bounds, resource outcomes and any completeness/cutoff theorem.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The claim is phrased to match bounded or unbounded evidence.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Finitisation effects are explicit and do not masquerade as concrete completeness.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Bounded fault/event schedules do not silently exclude the motivating failure.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Loop/data/participant bounds match the claimed implementation scenario.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Unwinding, SAT/SMT encoding and unknown/timeout handling are correct and visible.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Bounds and completeness arguments are versioned with the model/property and rerun after change.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Preserves the high bug-finding value and automation of bounded reasoning without allowing it to control unbounded correctness claims.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Bound omitted from reports or user interface.
Loop unwinding assumptions suppress deeper defects.
A small-scope hypothesis is treated as a theorem.
Integer/bit-width choice removes overflow or enlarges semantics incorrectly.
Timeout is converted into pass.
Benchmark success rewards shallow expected counterexamples and hides transfer limits.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: No counterexample up to k is not proof beyond k absent a completeness argument.
Small scopes often find structural bugs but there is no universal guarantee.
Bounds can be selected after seeing outcomes, enabling assurance gaming.
AI-generated specifications/benchmarks can leak expected theorem structure [S101, S111].
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Bounded search evolved with incremental SAT/SMT, k-induction, interpolation, completeness thresholds and explicit unwind checks. The mature property is not bounded checking itself but honest scope disclosure and escalation rules.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A bounded result states exact depth/scope/width/participants, resource termination, completeness status and decision meaning. It is accepted as proof only with a valid cutoff/diameter/induction argument; otherwise it is labelled strong bounded challenge or bug-finding evidence.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: BMC, CBMC and Alloy directly establish bounded reasoning and explicit finite scope.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: SAT-based checking is rigorous for the encoded finite horizon, assuming correct encoding.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Runs and bounds are mechanically replayable.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Bound disclosure does not establish model-code correspondence or unbounded behaviour.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: CBMC/Alloy and industrial SAT methods show strong bounded value.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Bug-finding success is well documented; universal cost/coverage effects are context-dependent.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Guidance requires sound scope/coverage treatment for certification credit.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Any bounded technique needs it; actual bounded method remains contextual.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Depth, width, scope, timeout and cutoff assumptions define the result.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Caricature and benchmark-transfer evidence directly constrain overclaiming.

For which domain patterns can trustworthy cutoffs be inferred automatically?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Explicit-state model checking encountered combinatorial state explosion; symbolic BDDs, partial-order and symmetry reductions, SAT-based bounded checking, abstraction and CEGAR were successive responses [S008, S009, S036, S061].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: The product of variables, processes, data values and interleavings makes exhaustive exploration computationally infeasible, causing tools to terminate, simplify away failure modes or consume more engineering effort than the risk warrants.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Partial-order/symmetry/symbolic/abstraction methods are retained as scalability mechanisms, not proof of model adequacy.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: The product of variables, processes, data values and interleavings makes exhaustive exploration computationally infeasible, causing tools to terminate, simplify away failure modes or consume more engineering effort than the risk warrants.
properties.MECHANISM: Exploit structure through symbolic state sets, partial-order equivalence, symmetry, abstraction, compositional decomposition, parameter cutoffs and bounded/SAT search. Measure explored state/transition counts, memory/time, reduction ratios and soundness conditions; retreat to focused properties/models when scale remains prohibitive.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger when state-space estimates or failed runs show combinatorial blow-up in a decision-relevant model.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Do not introduce sophisticated reductions for a small model; use direct exploration or a simpler invariant.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Property-preserving reduction theorem/condition, performance metrics and fallback decision rule.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The property is compatible with the equivalence/reduction used.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Independence, symmetry, cutoff or abstract-domain assumptions are justified.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Fault/environment behaviours are not selectively removed just to achieve tractability.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Reduction preserves implementation-relevant identities and event orders.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Reduction algorithms, hashing, symbolic encodings and resource termination statuses are trustworthy.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Model/property changes trigger state-space/reduction revalidation; cached reductions are not presumed reusable.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Extends exhaustive or systematic challenge to larger systems while retaining trace diagnostics and makes cost/scalability trade-offs explicit.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Reduction relies on an invalid independence relation.
Symbolic representation blows up despite compact headline potential.
Symmetry merges identities relevant to the property.
Abstraction produces endless spurious counterexamples.
Parameter cutoff is guessed rather than proved.
Scale pressure leads to omission of faults/data values without disclosure.
Optimal reduction search itself becomes computationally hard [S103].
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: No reduction eliminates worst-case complexity; scaling claims are structure-dependent.
Engineering effort to design abstractions/reductions can exceed direct testing or redesign.
State-count headlines are poor cross-model assurance metrics.
Reduction soundness says nothing about model adequacy.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: The field moved from larger hardware and explicit search to symbolic encodings, partial-order/symmetry algorithms, CEGAR, compositional and parameterised verification, and hybrid testing/model checking. Current complexity results reinforce that mature practice selects risk-focused models rather than promising universal exhaustive scale.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use reductions with explicit preservation arguments and report both reduced and conceptual scope. If tractability requires excluding material behaviours, narrow the claim or switch to hybrid evidence. State explosion is a method-selection constraint, not a reason to hide bounds.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Symbolic model checking, SPIN reductions, BMC and CEGAR provide direct historical lineage.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Reductions preserve results when their formal conditions hold.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Reduced searches are replayable with pinned heuristics/resources.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Scalability mechanisms do not improve model-code correspondence.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Symbolic/partial-order/abstraction methods underpin major tools and cases.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Industrial use is clear; comparative reduction cost/benefit varies widely.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Model checking and abstract interpretation are accepted in formal assurance with soundness obligations.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Every large model faces scale, but no single reduction transfers universally.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: System structure, property, independence, data bounds and resources determine success.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Foundational complexity and practical spuriousness evidence directly oppose “state explosion solved” claims.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: How can reduction soundness and omitted independence assumptions be reviewed cheaply?
Which learned heuristics improve scale without benchmark overfitting or hidden unsoundness?
When should a team stop refining a model and invest in architecture simplification or runtime evidence instead?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Vacuity detection arose in temporal model checking to identify formulas true because a subformula or antecedent was irrelevant. Specification mutation, satisfiability checking and coverage analysis broadened this into tests of whether a formal property can actually distinguish intended failures [S059, S060].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A proof may succeed because assumptions are inconsistent, initial states unreachable, antecedents never occur, behaviour disabled or the property too weak. The result is logically true but supplies little or no assurance.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: A green theorem/model-checking result must be challenged for vacuity, unreachable states and overly weak properties.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A proof may succeed because assumptions are inconsistent, initial states unreachable, antecedents never occur, behaviour disabled or the property too weak. The result is logically true but supplies little or no assurance.
properties.MECHANISM: Check model and assumption satisfiability; require witnesses for preconditions/initial states; perform semantic vacuity analysis; mutate property clauses, assumptions and transitions; test known negative examples; measure whether each clause affects outcomes; review proof obligations changed after failures.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger for critical temporal/invariant/contract/theorem claims, especially after unexpectedly easy proof or repeated specification changes.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a direct local predicate with obvious positive/negative unit cases, run those cases rather than a heavyweight vacuity framework.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Known good/bad examples, satisfiability tooling, mutation policy and auditable statement history.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: Assumptions and initial states have witnesses; each material clause can affect an allowed behaviour.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Vacuity is not an artefact of abstraction eliminating trigger behaviours.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: The environment model permits realistic triggering/failing cases.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Negative examples and triggers map to implementation/deployment scenarios where the claim is operational.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Vacuity/mutation engines preserve formula semantics and report unsupported constructs.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Specification and proof-obligation diffs are reviewed; strength tests replay after every relevant change.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Detects false confidence before release, exposes weak/irrelevant specifications, and makes proof success harder to obtain by excluding the problem.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: A request–response property passes because no request can occur.
An invariant is true only because initial states are empty.
An implication antecedent is permanently false.
A property omits the failing behaviour and remains green under mutation.
Engineers weaken the “golden theorem” until automation succeeds.
Generated specifications reproduce benchmark answers or expected examples rather than general intent.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Formula truth and proof checking do not measure specification strength.
Vacuity detectors themselves cover particular logics and definitions; nonvacuity is not full correctness.
Mutation scores can become another proxy and be gamed.
Human validation remains necessary to decide whether a changed clause matters to stakeholders.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: ACTL/LTL vacuity algorithms evolved into semantic vacuity, coverage, mutation model checking, proof-obligation audits, assumption consistency checks and generated-specification challenge sets. Current AI work adds held-out examples, roundtrip equivalence and contamination controls.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A critical formal property must demonstrate satisfiable scope, reachable meaningful cases, sensitivity to each material clause and rejection of known bad scenarios. The theorem/specification change history is reviewed to distinguish legitimate correction from proof gaming.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Beer and Kupferman–Vardi directly establish vacuity as a distinct verification-quality problem.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Semantic vacuity and satisfiability checks are formally rigorous for supported logics.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Vacuity/mutation runs are replayable with versioned model/property.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: A nonvacuous in-model property still may not correspond to code or stakeholder intent.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Vacuity is mature in hardware/model checking and increasingly relevant to software/specification practice.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Practitioner/AI translation evidence supports the risk; comparative field-effect evidence is limited.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: DO-333 requires meaningful coverage/soundness, though it does not reduce all weakness to a metric.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: The anti-vacuity principle transfers across logics even though algorithms differ.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Initial states, assumptions, triggers and environment determine whether truth is meaningful.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Foundational vacuity results and current translation evidence directly challenge proof-as-assurance proxies.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which specification-strength metrics correlate with field defect prevention rather than benchmark score?
How can vacuity and mutation analyses scale to theorem-prover specifications and hyperproperties?
What governance best distinguishes legitimate specification revision from outcome-driven weakening?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: LCF-style provers made every theorem derive through a small trusted inference kernel; HOL, Isabelle and Coq/Rocq developed interactive proof scripts, tactics and proof objects that could be replayed mechanically. Large verified-software projects turned replay into a build artefact [S042–S044, S050].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A persuasive hand proof, review note or one-time interactive session cannot reliably establish that every inference remains valid, that dependencies are available, or that the theorem still follows after change.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Critical logical arguments should be replayable by a proof checker against explicit assumptions when proof evidence is material.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A persuasive hand proof, review note or one-time interactive session cannot reliably establish that every inference remains valid, that dependencies are available, or that the theorem still follows after change.
properties.MECHANISM: Store theorem statement, proof source/term, assumptions, dependency graph, prover/library versions and deterministic build command. Re-run the kernel checker from a clean environment; archive logs and artefact hashes; distinguish reconstructed proof, admitted axiom and external oracle result.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger for any theorem intended to survive author/session context, support assurance credit or be independently consumed.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a tiny decidable check, a deterministic verifier/test with archived input/output may be more economical than an interactive proof development.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Pinned theorem source, proof artefact, dependency versions, build environment and clean replay command.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The replayed theorem is exactly the reviewed engineering statement; no unreviewed weakening or axiom change.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Model/abstraction version is bound to the proof identity.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: External assumptions are recorded; replay does not count as discharging them.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Source/model/binary identifiers consumed by the theorem are recorded separately.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Kernel, parser, logic definition, axioms and any proof-import checker are bounded.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Clean replay occurs after theorem, proof, model, code, library, prover or relevant configuration change.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Eliminates hand-waved inference steps, detects proof breakage early, supports independent review and archival reproducibility, and lets automation be used without trusting its reasoning narrative.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Proof script succeeds only with undeclared local state, cache or plugin.
Admitted axioms or unsafe commands are hidden in transitive dependencies.
Tactics are nondeterministic or time/resource sensitive.
The theorem replays but refers to a stale model or old code version.
A proof term is unavailable, so success depends on a large tactic/solver stack.
Library/prover upgrade breaks proof despite unchanged intended theorem.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Mechanical replay validates derivation, not requirement translation, assumptions or implementation correspondence.
Large proof builds can be expensive, brittle and difficult to reproduce [S095, S096].
A short replay log may hide a large trusted base or generated code path.
A proof that compiles after theorem weakening is current syntactically but not semantically equivalent.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Interactive checking evolved into proof terms, declarative proofs, continuous proof builds, dependency manifests, hermetic containers, proof certificates and independent reconstruction. Current proof engineering treats proofs as maintained software with regression and provenance.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A proof claim is accepted only with a clean, repeatable kernel check tied to exact theorem/model/code identities and a disclosed assumption/dependency set. Replay failure is an assurance failure; replay success is scoped to the checked statement and version.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: HOL/Isabelle/Coq and verified-software practice directly establish kernel-based replay.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Kernel checking provides strong evidence that the formal derivation follows in the declared logic.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Replay is the property itself when artefacts and environment are complete.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Replay does not connect the theorem to current implementation or environment.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: CompCert, seL4, VST and CakeML maintain replayable proof corpora.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: The Isabelle compatibility study supplies large empirical evidence of replay breakage; productivity comparisons remain limited.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Machine-replayable formal evidence is central to high-assurance use, subject to tool qualification and scope.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Universal within mechanised proof, but unnecessary for simple non-theorem checks.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Logic, axioms, dependencies, resources and identity determine what replay establishes.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Compatibility and specification evidence strongly constrain “proof once passed” confidence.

OPEN_QUESTIONS: Which proof artefact formats best support long-term replay across prover evolution?
How can large dependency graphs be summarised without concealing axioms or semantic changes?

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: The LCF architecture concentrated trust in a small kernel; proof-carrying code shifted checking to a small consumer; proof-producing SAT/SMT and certificate reconstruction extended this idea beyond interactive theorem provers [S022, S042–S044, S108, S109].

properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Certificates justify abstraction/preprocessing transformations relevant to soundness.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Physical/deployment assumptions remain outside logical certificate unless separately represented.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Certificate covers the transformation/model relation actually used, not only a back-end formula.

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Early formal proofs were often published as fixed mathematical artefacts. properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Code, specifications, libraries, tactics and provers evolve. A previously checked proof can fail, silently target an old artefact, or be “repaired” by changing the theorem. Proof cost therefore includes lifetime maintenance, not only initial construction.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Proofs must replay after code/spec/library/tool changes or be marked stale.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Code, specifications, libraries, tactics and provers evolve. properties.MECHANISM: Track theorem/proof/model/code dependency graphs; run proofs continuously; classify semantic versus syntactic breakage; perform change-impact analysis; review theorem and assumption diffs; use automated repair only with replay and equivalence checks; budget ownership and deprecation.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger for proofs intended to govern evolving production artefacts or survive tool/library upgrades.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For one-off exploratory proofs with no future consumer, archive scope and do not create a permanent maintenance obligation.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Version control, dependency graph, proof owner, CI/replay resources and semantic review process.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: Statement and assumption diffs are first-class review items, not hidden inside proof repair.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Abstraction interfaces are stable or their downstream proof impact is known.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Changes in configuration/platform assumptions enter the dependency graph.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Code/model linkage detects when implementation changes should invalidate or rerun proof.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Prover/library/tactic/solver version changes are captured and revalidated.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Continuous clean replay and semantic diff review are mandatory; age alone is not currentness.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents stale assurance, exposes maintenance cost before adoption, preserves trustworthy change velocity and supports selective investment in stable critical interfaces.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.

Automation change finds a different proof but obscures changed assumptions.
Code change has no dependency edge to the proof model, leaving it falsely green.
Proof repair weakens the statement or adds axioms.
Forked libraries prevent reproducible replay.
Maintenance cost causes teams to freeze code or abandon proof artefacts.

Automated repair may optimise compilation rather than preserve engineering meaning.

properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A formal result has an owner, dependency manifest, clean continuous replay, theorem/assumption diff review, impact rules and retirement threshold. Repair is accepted only when the checked claim is unchanged or the change is explicitly revalidated.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Replay is the primary detector of syntactic/tool incompatibility.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: A current proof can still target a stale model unless correspondence dependencies are explicit.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: CompCert, seL4, VST and AFP demonstrate sustained maintenance, though public cost detail varies.

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: SAT decision procedures and SMT combination frameworks enabled automated discharge over propositional logic, arithmetic, arrays, bit-vectors and uninterpreted functions. Modern program verifiers encode proof obligations into SMT, often trusting front-end translation and solver answers [S038–S041].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: An UNSAT/SAT result can be wrong because the engineering property was encoded incorrectly, arithmetic/bit widths differ, quantifiers trigger incompletely, the solver returns UNKNOWN/timeout, or the solver itself has a soundness defect.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: SAT/SMT results require checked encodings, theory declarations, solver version/status and certificate strategy where risk warrants.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: An UNSAT/SAT result can be wrong because the engineering property was encoded incorrectly, arithmetic/bit widths differ, quantifiers trigger incompletely, the solver returns UNKNOWN/timeout, or the solver itself has a soundness defect.
properties.MECHANISM: Specify logic/theories and exact encoding; distinguish SAT, UNSAT, UNKNOWN and timeout; cross-check or fuzz solvers; validate front-end translation; request proof certificates/unsat cores/models; reconstruct critical UNSAT proofs independently; test floating-point and nonlinear corner semantics.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever an SMT/SAT result discharges a material proof obligation or controls acceptance.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: For a small decidable predicate, use a direct evaluator/exhaustive table; for low-risk checks, archive solver inputs and cross-check selectively.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Exact formula/encoding, theory semantics, solver/options, result handling and certificate/cross-check policy.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: Engineering units, domains, undefined behaviour and quantification are represented faithfully.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Encoding approximations and theory relaxations preserve the claimed direction.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Hardware numerical semantics and runtime domains match the encoded theory.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Verification-condition generator and front-end translation are validated or trusted explicitly.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Solver, parser, preprocessing, certificate producer/checker and front-end translator are bounded.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Formula, encoder, solver/options or theory-version changes require new result/certificate.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Retains high automation and scalability while reducing false proof from encoding and solver defects, and makes solver outputs reproducible and diagnosable.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: Wrong sign, units, quantifier scope or bit-vector width in encoding.
Timeout/UNKNOWN is coerced to success or failure.
Solver model is misinterpreted because of partial/underspecified functions.
Unsat core omits a preprocessing bug or is treated as proof of requirement relevance.
Solver soundness bug returns false UNSAT [S097].
Front-end to intermediate-language translation is unsound [S098].
Floating-point operation is approximated as real arithmetic.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: SMT automation can make the most trusted step the least visible to engineers.
Solver diversity may share algorithms/code or the same encoding error.
Certificates can be huge or incomplete for preprocessing/theory reasoning [S108, S109].
Unsat cores explain logical dependence, not engineering correctness.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Raw solver trust evolved toward standardised SMT-LIB, differential fuzzing, model validation, proof-producing solvers, Alethe/LRAT-style certificates, independent reconstruction and certifying verifier front ends. Mature use scales trust controls with consequence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: A solver-mediated claim records formula hash, logic, solver/version/options, result class and encoding source. properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Independent certificate reconstruction gives strong replay; raw solver logs give less.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: SMT underpins major program verifiers, static analyses and hardware/software checks.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: OpFuzz documents hundreds of confirmed soundness bugs; controlled benefit comparisons are less direct.

CERTIFICATION_OR_DOMAIN_PRACTICE_STRENGT.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Critical assurance demands sound method/tool treatment; raw solver branding is insufficient.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Solver/encoding trust applies wherever SMT/SAT is used, but certificate intensity is contextual.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Encoding, theory, result class, preprocessing and solver version determine validity.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Solver-bug and verifier-translation evidence directly contradicts blind trust.

properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: King’s symbolic execution represented inputs symbolically and accumulated path conditions; KLEE and modern concolic tools coupled path exploration with constraint solvers and test generation [S085, S034, S035].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: Concrete tests cover one input/path at a time and miss deep branches. Symbolic execution can systematically generate inputs that exercise paths and reveal assertion, memory, arithmetic or protocol failures.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Symbolic execution gives path evidence and generated tests under explicit path/environment/solver bounds.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: Concrete tests cover one input/path at a time and miss deep branches. Symbolic execution can systematically generate inputs that exercise paths and reveal assertion, memory, arithmetic or protocol failures.
properties.MECHANISM: Execute program semantics over symbolic values, fork at branches, solve path constraints, generate concrete witnesses and combine with search heuristics, state merging, summaries, concolic execution and environment models. Report path/time bounds and solver UNKNOWN separately.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger for input-rich, branch-heavy code where concrete witness generation is valuable and semantics/environment can be modelled.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use fuzzing/property-based tests for cheap broad exploration, or direct proof/static analysis when all-path assurance is required and tractable.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Executable semantics, constraint theories, environment models, search/bound disclosure and concrete replay harness.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: Assertions/properties checked are meaningful and not merely crash proxies.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Stubs, summaries and state merging preserve witness validity or are labelled approximate.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: System calls, files, network, time and nondeterminism are modelled or bounded explicitly.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Generated witness is replayed on the actual implementation/build where feasible.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Symbolic interpreter, solver, constraint encoding and concrete test generator are trusted/tested.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Witnesses and exploration campaigns rerun after code/semantics/environment changes.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Finds difficult path-specific defects and produces reproducible inputs more efficiently than manual test design for suitable code.

Environment/system calls are stubbed unrealistically.
Constraint solver cannot decide nonlinear, floating-point or complex theories.
Infeasible paths consume resources due to weak constraints.
Loop/recursion bounds hide deeper failures.
Undefined behaviour or language semantics differ from the symbolic interpreter.
High branch coverage is treated as functional correctness.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Path coverage is not environment or behavioural completeness.
Generated tests inherit the symbolic semantics and stubs; differential execution is needed.
Search heuristics can overfit familiar benchmarks or shallow defects.
Symbolic execution is often strongest as test generation, not proof.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Pure symbolic execution evolved into concolic execution, selective/path-directed search, compositional summaries, state merging, fuzzing hybrids and bounded model checking. Mature practice uses it to generate high-value witnesses and tests with explicit scope rather than claiming universal verification.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Use symbolic execution for path-sensitive bug finding or focused bounded proof, with exact loop/path/environment bounds, concrete replay of witnesses and complementary fuzzing/testing. Universal claims require a completeness argument or another method.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: King, KLEE and surveys give direct symbolic-execution lineage.

FORMAL_SOUNDNESS_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Path-condition reasoning is strong for represented semantics; completeness is usually absent.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Generated path constraints and concrete witnesses are replayable.

INDUSTRIAL_CASE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: KLEE and later industrial/research tools show practical bug-finding value.

EMPIRICAL_COMPARATIVE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Numerous defect studies exist, but comparative field effectiveness depends on domain and harness.

TRANSFERABILITY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Strong for path-sensitive software; weak for open concurrency or opaque environments.

ASSUMPTION_SENSITIVITY.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Bounds, stubs, solver theories and language semantics define coverage.

Which hybrid fuzzing/symbolic policies give robust transfer beyond benchmark suites?

properties.PROPERTY_NAME: Sound versus unsound static analysis boundary
properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: static analysis and abstract interpretation lineage
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Abstract interpretation framed sound static analysis as conservative approximation; industrial analysers such as Astrée pursued absence-of-runtime-error claims, while many developer-oriented analysers deliberately traded soundness for speed and usability [S005, S032, S033].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: A green static-analysis dashboard is ambiguous unless users know whether the analyser over-approximates all behaviours, intentionally misses cases, suppresses warnings, or only applies to a language/platform subset.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Static analysis claims must identify whether the analysis is sound for the language/property and what false positives/negatives mean.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: A green static-analysis dashboard is ambiguous unless users know whether the analyser over-approximates all behaviours, intentionally misses cases, suppresses warnings, or only applies to a language/platform subset.
properties.MECHANISM: Publish the soundness target, concrete semantics, supported constructs, false-negative policy and alarm interpretation. For sound analysers, treat alarms as possible behaviours requiring triage/refinement; for unsound analysers, treat green as heuristic evidence only. Measure suppressions and unanalysed code.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever a static analyser’s green/red result is used as evidence beyond local developer feedback.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use fast unsound linting freely for low-risk feedback, but label it and do not demand proof-grade governance.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Documented language/platform semantics, soundness target, supported-code inventory and suppression governance.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The defect classes checked are named; no warning is not conflated with functional correctness.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Transfer functions and widening preserve soundness for claimed classes.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Libraries, concurrency, inputs and hardware assumptions are within analyser semantics.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: The exact source/build analysed is captured and unsupported portions identified.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Front end, abstract interpreter, solver and configuration are qualified/tested proportionally.
properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Analysis reruns on source/config/tool changes; suppressions expire or are revalidated.
properties.EXPECTED_ENGINEERING_PAYOFF: Prevents overclaiming green dashboards, helps teams balance false positives against missed defects, and directs qualification effort to analysers whose absence claims matter.
properties.DECISION_OR_CONSUMER: Designer, reviewer, safety/security assessor, maintainer, release gate, certifier, operator, or downstream verifier.
KNOWN_FAILURE_MODES: An unsound analyser’s silence is marketed as proof.
A sound analyser’s false positives are mass-suppressed without justification.
Unsupported language/assembly/library constructs are skipped.
Concurrency/environment semantics are approximated inadequately.
Widening or configuration loses useful precision.
A warning count becomes an assurance proxy independent of severity/coverage.
IMPORTANT_CRITICISMS: Soundness can impose false-positive and usability costs; unsoundness can improve adoption but weakens absence claims.
The analyser’s concrete semantics may differ from compiler/hardware behaviour.
Domain-specific success such as Astrée may not transfer to arbitrary software.
Suppression and configuration governance can dominate theoretical soundness.
properties.HOW_THE_PROPERTY_EVOLVED: Static analysis diversified into sound domain-specific analysers, scalable unsound bug finders, gradual verification, refinement types and proof-producing/certified analyses. Mature practice makes the soundness/coverage contract explicit and chooses the trade-off by decision consequence.
properties.MATURE_OR_EVOLVED_FORM: Every static-analysis result declares whether absence of warnings is a sound guarantee, a bounded guarantee or a heuristic. Unsupported code, suppressions and modelling assumptions are measurable; high-consequence claims use sound or independently validated analysis.
properties.CEREMONY_VS_PROPERTY: Notation, tool brand, proof count, certification label or 'formally verified' marketing is not the property; the retained property is the bounded checkable claim.

MECHANICAL_REPLAY_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Static analyses are readily repeatable with pinned source/configuration.

MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_STRENGTH.PROPERTY_SPECIFIC_BASIS: Source binding can be strong, but compiler/hardware/environment and skipped code remain boundaries.

properties.HISTORICAL_ORIGIN: type system and dependent type lineage
properties.ORIGINAL_FORM: Type systems formalised well-formedness and type safety through progress/preservation; dependent, refinement, ownership, effect and session types later encoded richer properties in typing judgements [S045–S047, S089].
properties.PROBLEM_IT_ADDRESSED: “Type-safe” is often inflated into “correct”. Ordinary typing prevents specific representation and operation mismatches but may say nothing about algorithmic result, liveness, security policy, numerical validity or stakeholder requirement.
properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Type safety, memory safety and noninterference are retained as precise claims, not functional correctness by implication.
properties.FAILURE_MODE_IT_TRIES_TO_PREVENT: “Type-safe” is often inflated into “correct”. Ordinary typing prevents specific representation and operation mismatches but may say nothing about algorithmic result, liveness, security policy, numerical validity or stakeholder requirement.
properties.MECHANISM: State the exact typing theorem and excluded stuck/error classes; map each type feature to an engineering claim; identify unsafe casts, foreign interfaces, dynamic checks and semantic gaps. Use richer types only where the encoded proposition and proof obligations justify the cost.
properties.TRIGGER_OR_CONTEXT: Trigger whenever type safety, Rust ownership, session/refinement/dependent types or “compiles” is used as an assurance claim.
properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use ordinary types for ordinary representation safety; do not encode volatile business logic at the type level without clear payoff.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Published language/type soundness scope, compiler/runtime assumptions and inventory of unsafe/dynamic boundaries.
properties.SPECIFICATION_PRECONDITIONS: The proposition encoded by the type matches the claimed failure class.
properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Type abstraction does not hide value/behaviour distinctions material to clients.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: External data and foreign components are validated before entering trusted typed invariants.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Compiler/runtime faithfully implements the type semantics and deployed code avoids unchecked escape hatches.
properties.TRUSTED_TOOL_PRECONDITIONS: Type checker, compiler, elaborator, SMT back end and unsafe libraries are bounded.

properties.ENGINEERING_CLAIM: Specification-rich types can carry selected proof obligations when properties fit type-level automation/review.

properties.NON_TRIGGER_OR_CHEAP_PATH: Use runtime validation or ordinary types for volatile policy, uncertain sensor input or properties whose proof cost exceeds reuse value.
properties.DEPENDENCIES_OR_PRECONDITIONS: Stable invariant, supporting libraries/automation, programmer expertise and bounded extraction/unsafe interfaces.

properties.ABSTRACTION_PRECONDITIONS: Type indices/refinements preserve relevant runtime semantics after erasure.
properties.ENVIRONMENT_PRECONDITIONS: Untrusted external inputs are checked before constructing trusted typed values.
properties.MODEL_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE_PRECONDITIONS: Elaboration, extraction/compiler and FFI preserve typed guarantees.

properties.CURRENTNESS_OR_REPLAY_PRECONDITIONS: Types/proofs rebuild after API/library/tool changes; repaired types are semantically diff-reviewed.
